edge_explainer: CAUSE (primary-verified): the May-21 -7.27% (30.2M sh, 2.9x avg) was NOT a miss and NOT a guide cut. Q1 FY27 BEAT its own 02-19 guide (adj EPS $0.66 vs $0.63-0.65; net sales +5.9% cc vs +3.5-4.5%) and FY27 was reiterated UNCHANGED. Four things did it, all disclosed in the same release: (1) reiterate-not-raise banked the beat, leaving implied H2 FY27 growth of 0% at the guide low end; (2) Walmart U.S. gross profit +29bps but opex DELEVERAGED 56bps -> segment operating margin -27bps, on higher depreciation (automation capex ~3.5% of sales) and healthcare costs; (3) a 250bps operating-income drag from higher FUEL in distribution/fulfillment (CEO's own paragraph); (4) FCF -$1.9B, a -$2.4B YoY swing, with inventory +8.9% vs revenue +7.3%. RULING: de-rate, not derailment - no guidance revision has occurred (last 8-K 2026-06-05 was the annual meeting). BUT THE FRAME'S SECOND HALF FAILS: this is not quality at an own-history discount. Verified from four primary Q4 releases + IBKR monthly closes, adj EPS $2.10 (FY23) / $2.22 (FY24) / $2.51 (FY25) / $2.64 (FY26) / $2.75-2.85 (FY27 guide) = 7.5%/yr compounding, while the trailing multiple went 22.6x -> 26.4x -> 39.1x -> 48.5x. Price +170% Feb-23 to Feb-26 on +26% earnings: two-thirds of the three-year return was multiple expansion. The -17.6% drawdown gives back 6.6 of 25.9 turns - ~25% of the re-rate - leaving 39.5x forward, essentially the Feb-2025 level. FY27 guides +6.1% EPS growth, identical to FY24's +5.7% BEFORE any 'transformation'; PEG ~6.5 on a 0.87% yield. MARGIN-TRANSFORMATION LEGS ARE REAL IN THE TOP LINE AND ABSENT IN THE BOTTOM: advertising +37%, membership fee revenue +17.4%, eCommerce +26% - and consolidated gross profit rate rose SIX bps while U.S. operating margin contracted. Two disclosure asymmetries (review flags, not ELEVATE): the global advertising BASE is not disclosed in dollars anywhere in the 10-K/10-Q/8-K (only the growth rate - the '$5.4B advertising costs' line is WMT's own ad EXPENSE, an easy misread), and the release headlines 'membership fee revenue +17.4%' while the 10-K shows its parent line 'membership and other income' grew 4.7% in FY26. GLP-1/mix, quantified: Walmart U.S. health & wellness was $69.5B in FY26 (+12.0%) and supplied ~$7.5B of the segment's $20.6B growth - 36% of ALL segment growth, in retail's lowest-gross-margin category - then went to +0.7% in Q1 FY27 (Sam's -1.9%). Cuts both ways: top-line hole (bear) vs gross-margin-accretive mix (bull, and U.S. GP did print +29bps); driver PLAUSIBLE not confirmed. TARIFF LEG = WASH (differentiated, primary-sourced): the 05-21 guide states verbatim it 'does not assume any impact from IEEPA tariff refunds' and the 10-Q states the refund claim is unrecognized - a textbook house B_skew - yet WMT is ABSENT from all 168 issuers in TARIFF_REFUND_COHORT.json; root cause is the builder's fetch cap (efts_docs_matched 1214 vs docs_fetched 900), i.e. our generator is blind to the largest US importer (defect to fix, not a finding about WMT). 'America's largest importer' is REFUTED as a sensitivity claim: the 10-Q says 'less than one third of what we sell in the U.S. is imported', sourcing already spread across China/Vietnam/Mexico/India/Canada. The regime swap is a clean natural experiment and the tape priced it flat: 122 sunset week 07-22->07-28 +3.45%, 301 substitution week 07-28->08-04 -2.25%, net +1.13%. Basis read: forced-labor 301 is harder per-unit on targeted lines (apparel/textiles/cotton) but has no sunset and is sourceable-around, vs 122's flat uniform 15%/150-day cap - relatively FAVORABLE to WMT vs the general-merchandise cohort (DG/DLTR/FIVE/TGT/ROST all in the 168), roughly neutral absolute. Per the ISRG informed-caution lesson: GAAP gain-contingency rules REQUIRE the exclusion - that is compliance, not conservatism, and it is not an informational moat. TAPE PREMISE REFUTED: the seed's '~20-vol staple, 3+ sigma-months' is wrong - pre-break realized vol (02-09..05-19, n=70) is 25.0% annualized, so the 77-day 1-sigma is 13.8% and the -17.6% drawdown is 1.27 SIGMA, an ordinary drift. Post-print realized vol 23.6% is LOWER than pre-break: no capitulation, no volume climax, no dislocation premium. MODE-B MECHANISM (the transferable output): masking channel = NONE (issuer grades CLEAN on honesty - the 250bps fuel drag is in the CEO's own paragraph, the 56bps deleverage in the segment bullets, the -$1.9B FCF in the balance-sheet box, the reiterate-not-raise is the headline bullet) x signal channel = the market's own multiple vs the issuer's own disclosed growth rate x latency = quarters-to-years with no event trigger. When the masking channel is empty there is no 'truth comes out' catalyst - the truth was always out - so the de-rate has no floor except valuation and decays on the slow clock of successive in-line prints. CORROLLARY FOR THE SCREEN: at equal drawdown a CLEAN issuer is the WORSE long, because nothing is left to be revealed. Anti-masking finding: catalog it. AI-BREAK@0.45: WMT is an AI ADOPTER, not AI-capex-levered; entry does NOT require the cycle to hold and a break plausibly rotates INTO staples, making it a mild hedge to the household's ~$5.2M/26% AI-complex exposure - but that is beta, not alpha, and does not earn a slot at 39.5x. Market-implied p(bull) ~0.55 at spot vs our 0.20: a 35pp divergence on the SHORT side, not taken (never auto-short; a valuation finding gates on price, it does not invert). SCREEN DEFECT NOTED PER SEED: the quality-drawdown band starting at -35% would have missed this name entirely - but on this evidence that was the RIGHT exclusion for the wrong reason; the correct fix is to add a multiple-vs-own-history gate, not merely a vol-adjusted drawdown gate, since vol-adjusting alone would have surfaced a 1.27-sigma non-event.
